# Decision Suite

Decision Suite is a browser-based collection of tools for thinking through decisions, testing assumptions, planning for failure, and tracking commitments. Its public decision frameworks are interactive and available without signing in.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/landing): Overview of the decision toolkit and free frameworks.
- [Pricing](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/pricing): Free tier and Pro ($9/month) with unlimited entries, AI tools, cloud sync, and export.
- [About](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/about): Why Decision Suite exists and what it believes about decision-making.

## Public framework guides
- [Framework library](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/frameworks): Browse six decision frameworks.
- [RICE](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/frameworks/rice): Prioritize initiatives with Reach, Impact, Confidence, and Effort; includes a worked example and calculator.
- [Eisenhower Matrix](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/frameworks/eisenhower-matrix): Sort tasks by urgency and importance.
- [SWOT analysis](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/frameworks/swot-analysis): Examine strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.
- [Six Thinking Hats](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/frameworks/six-thinking-hats): Explore facts, feelings, risks, benefits, alternatives, and process.
- [ICE Score](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/frameworks/ice-score): Rank ideas by Impact, Confidence, and Ease.
- [PDCA cycle](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/frameworks/pdca-cycle): Plan, Do, Check, and Act in an improvement loop.

## App
- [Decision Suite](https://thedecisionapp-studio.lovable.app/): Assumption Audit, Decision Clarity, Pre-Mortem Studio, Commitment Ledger, One-Page OS, Templates Library, Devil's Advocate, and Assumption Extractor.
